# Webik Digital

> SEC-registered digital agency in Cebu, Philippines. AI-accelerated, human-perfected websites and digital marketing for SMEs and international clients.

## About
Webik Digital (Webik Corp) is a Cebu-based digital agency offering web design, web development, SEO, AEO, Google Ads, digital marketing, branding, e-commerce, and website maintenance. Founded by Pryce Oscar Resma. Serves clients in the Philippines, United States, United Kingdom, and worldwide.

## Team
- Pryce Oscar Resma — Founder & CEO
- Ray Mendoza — Chief Operating Officer
- Julius Parungao — Creative Director
- Xavier Gonzales — Head of Web Development

## Services
- Web Design — Custom mobile-first websites built on Bricks Builder
- Web Development — WordPress, Shopify, GitHub deployment
- SEO Services — Technical, on-page, and local SEO
- AEO / Schema Optimization — Structured data for AI search
- Google Ads Management — Search, Display, Performance Max
- Digital Marketing — Full-service strategy and execution
- Branding & Logo Design — Visual identity systems
- E-commerce Development — Shopify and WooCommerce
- Social Media Management — All major platforms
- Email Marketing — Automation and campaigns
- Content Writing — SEO and AEO-optimized
- Website Maintenance — Guardian Care Plan

## Pricing
The Launchpad: ₱5,000 setup. Guardian Care Plan: monthly subscription.
